snippet.title: Into the Depths - Launch Trailer | A Minimalistic Roguelite City Builder
snippet.description:
Into the Depths is OUT NOW on Steam

Delve underground and colonize the caves below. Build subterranean settlements from cards, invest in new technologies and descend deeper into the abyss. You'll encounter plenty of puzzle-like challenges where careful city planning and resource management are required to overcome.

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3705150/Into_The_Depths/
